Remote Business Development Executive (Female) Job at Kaplo Africa




        
    

        
        Kaplo is Africa's most innovative Human Resource & Business Support Solutions provider, serving clients with cutting-edge business advisory and human capital solutions across diverse sectors of the African economy.

At Kaplo, we have proven expertise in business advisory and human resource capabilities targeted at productivity, profitability, sustainability, transformation and overall growth of your business.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Remote Business Development Executive (Female)

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-Time (Remote)
Industry: Real Estate

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced, confident, and results-driven Business Development Executive with a proven track record in real estate sales.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for generating qualified leads, acquiring clients, closing property sales, and building long-term relationships with investors and prospective buyers.
	The ideal candidate should possess strong sales expertise, excellent negotiation skills, and a deep understanding of the real estate market.
	She should be commercially minded, target-driven, and capable of delivering consistent revenue growth.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and develop new business opportunities within the real estate market.
	Generate qualified leads through prospecting, networking, referrals, and strategic partnerships.
	Market and sell the company’s real estate products and investment opportunities.
	Conduct property presentations, inspections, and client meetings.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients.
	Negotiate and close property sales while ensuring exceptional customer experience.
	Develop and implement strategies to achieve assigned monthly and annual sales targets.
	Maintain an active sales pipeline and provide regular business development reports.
	Conduct market research to identify emerging trends and investment opportunities.
	Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless client onboarding and transaction processes.
	Represent the company at property exhibitions, networking events, and other marketing engagements.
	Deliver exceptional after-sales relationship management to encourage repeat business and referrals.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree or HND in Business Administration, Marketing, Estate Management, Economics, or a related discipline.
	3–5 years of proven experience in business development or sales within the real estate industry.
	Demonstrated experience in successfully selling real estate properties and achieving sales targets.
	Strong knowledge of the Lagos real estate market and property investment.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and CRM tools is an added advantage.
	Female candidates are preferred for this role.
	Candidates must be based in Lagos.


Salary
N40,000 Monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using “Remote Business Development Executive (Female) – Real Estate” as the subject of the mail.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Treasury Manager Job at Opay Microfinance Bank




        
    

        
        Opay Microfinance Bank is a leading microfinance bank and financial technology institution committed to delivering innovative, fast, and secure financial solutions across Africa. We are driven by a passion for financial inclusion and excellence.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Treasury Manager
Job Location: Adeniyi Jones, Lagos

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Treasury Manager to oversee and manage the treasury operations of OPay Microfinance Bank.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring liquidity, managing investments, and maintaining the highest standards of financial reporting and compliance.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee bank account reconciliation and prepare accurate and timely bank reports
	Manage daily cash positioning and liquidity to ensure the organisation's financial obligations are consistently met.
	Ensure sufficient funds are available to support on going operational and capital investment requirements
	Prepare comprehensive treasury reports and ensure strict adherence to internal controls, treasury policies, and regulatory standards.
	Oversee the management of investments, including treasury bills, fixed deposits, and mutual funds.
	Monitor bank investments and advise on whether to roll over or terminateat maturity
	Liaise with the CFO and provide strategic financial insights to support decision-making.
	Perform any other functions as may be assigned by the CFO.


Requirements & Qualifications


	Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
	A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in treasury management or a similar finance role.
	Experience in Financial Services, Fintech, or Digital Bankingis a strong advantage.
	Strong knowledge of treasury operations, cash management, and investment instruments.
	Proficiency in financial reporting and treasury management systems.
	In-depth understanding of CBN regulations and financial compliance standards.
	Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
	Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
	Professional certifications such as ACA, ACCA, CFA, or CTP are an added advantage.

Business Developer Job at PalmPay




        
    

        
        PalmPay is a financial service provided by PalmPay Limited, licensed and regulated by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN). Deposits are insured by the Nigerian Deposit Insurance Corporation (NDIC). We empower individuals and businesses with payments solutions, high-yield investment opportunities, and easy-to-use tools for financial management. We are a global company with a presence in Nigeria, Ghana, Tanzania, and the United Kingdom.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Business Developer

Job Locations: Abuja (FCT), Abia,  Akwa Ibom, Anambra, Cross River, Delta, Imo and Rivers
Employment Type: Contract

Description
     

            
    




	The Business Developer will be responsible for identifying and onboarding business owners (merchants) to use Flexi MFB’s Pay With Transfer solution.
	This is a field-based role that requires daily engagement with customers.


Key Responsibilities


	Approach and engage business owners in markets and commercial areas
	Educate customers on the benefits of Pay With Transfer (PWT), training will be provided.
	Onboard and assist merchants in opening business accounts
	Meet daily and weekly onboarding targets


Requirements


	0-1 years of experience in sales related role.
	Immediate resumption is prioritized.
	Must reside in states advertised for vacancy.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills
	Energetic, confident, and target-driven.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using “Business Developer” and indicating state of residence as the subject of the email.
